3573-6474-8260.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3573-6474-8260.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.

141-3905-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3905-5686.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

883-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

862-1591-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1591-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1526-4644-7791.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Circle of Dreams Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

3587-3614-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3587-3614-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Heroic Intervention.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3587-3614-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

3532-5078-5402-7692.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1829-2469-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-950-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

654-2404-6507-7115.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
654-2404-6507-7115.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
654-2404-6507-7115.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing a land that wasn't tapped for mana in step 1.
Toph's second ability triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending another land you control.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing the land that was earthbent in step 6.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning the sacrificed land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land that entered by tapping it adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.
654-2404-6507-7115.notes: If the other land that is recurred doesn't produce mana, you must control four or more creatures for the combo to function.

250-779-1479-5411-6528.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-6528.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

864-1987-3277-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1987-3277-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Izzet Chronarch.
When Eternal Witness and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-3277-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2440-3464-4055-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout
2440-3464-4055-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
When the token Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Hyrax Tower Scout trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Hyrax Tower Scout for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

225-3129-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
225-3129-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sicknes.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-3129-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 4 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

413-678-1003.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4846-5257.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}.
4846-5257.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Riku's second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Resolve the Riku trigger, causing you to pay {G}{U} to create a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The token Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling all other permanents you control.
The nontoken Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Worldgorger Dragon trigger from step 2, exiling the token Worldgorger Dragon.
The token Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning all permanents exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

14-147-5147.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

224-3814-4967.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
224-3814-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers and the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

549-1740-2034-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
Biotransference triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and create a 2/2 Necron Warrior token.
Leonin Relic-Warder's ETB ability triggers, exiling Extraction Specialist.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding {C}{C}.
Leonin Relic-Warder's LTB ability triggers, returning Extraction Specialist from exile to the battlefield.
Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

546-2646-4499.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
546-2646-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ramos and causing Ramos to enter with at least five +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3181-4019.notablePrerequisites:
Krosan Restorer has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
There are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
You control three lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3181-4019.description:
Activate three mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Krosan Restorer's second ability by tapping it, untapping the three lands.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Repeat.

568-2104-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
568-2104-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library.
Cast Capsize for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
